# Working of Merge Sort

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Working of Merge Sort

Suppose we have the following unsorted vector.

![Unsorted vector](data:image/png;base64,)

Here's how we can use merge sort to sort this vector.

1. Divide the vector into two halves.

![Divide Vector Into Two Parts](data:image/png;base64,)

First, we'll divide our vector over the midpoint which is 7 in our case.

Our vector has an odd number of elements, so the two halves differ by one element.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

2. Continue dividing each half recursively until we get individual elements.

![Recursively Divide Subparts](data:image/png;base64,)

3. Merge the individual elements in a sorted manner.

Here, the conquer and combine steps go side by side.

![Merge Sort](data:image/png;base64,)
